what: RTX makes aircraft engines (Pratt & Whitney), aircraft systems and parts (Collins Aerospace) and missiles, radars and air defence (Raytheon).
customers: Airlines, Airbus and Boeing, the US Department of Defense and allied governments.
money: avionics, interiors, landing systems and spare parts
commercial and military engines and their servicing
missiles, sensors and air defence such as Patriot
moat: An installed base of engines and parts that earns service revenue for decades, plus long defence programmes.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 10% last year and about 10% a year over three years
Aircraft are flying more hours, which drives high-margin engine aftermarket work
European rearmament raises demand for its missile and defence systems
watch: Commercial aftermarket revenue and the defence backlog.
